meta.name: Monitor pharma regulatory updates with Anthropic Claude and Slack alerts

parameters.content:
## Pharmaceutical Regulatory Intelligence Monitor

Watches official regulatory publications (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, etc.) for anything relevant to your therapeutic areas and products, uses Claude to classify each relevant publication and summarize its practical implications, and automatically opens a compliance action ticket routed by urgency — with an immediate alert for anything time-sensitive.

### How it works
1. A scheduled poll checks the regulatory source API for newly published items; a Manual Trigger lets you test on demand.
2. HTTP - Fetch Regulatory Publications pulls the latest publications list. JS - Normalize & Deduplicate Publications reshapes the response and drops anything already seen in a prior cycle (tracked in workflow static data, no external DB needed).
3. If nothing new was published, the cycle ends immediately — no AI call, no noise.
4. JS - Filter by Monitored Therapeutic Areas & Products keeps only publications tagged to what you actually care about. If none are relevant, the cycle ends here too.
5. Each relevant publication is fanned out individually, its full text fetched, and Claude classifies the affected therapeutic area(s)/product(s), summarizes the implications in plain language, and assesses urgency (Urgent vs Routine) with concrete compliance actions.
6. A Switch routes Urgent items to an immediate high-priority ticket + Slack alert; Routine items get a normal-priority ticket without the alert.
7. Both paths merge, post a summary to the regulatory intelligence channel, and record the publication as seen so next cycle only looks at what's truly new.

### Setup
1. Import this workflow into n8n and activate it.
2. Add credentials: your regulatory publications source API on the fetch nodes, your ticketing system (Jira/ServiceNow/etc.) API on the ticket-creation nodes, Anthropic Claude, and Slack.
3. Edit Set - Config: monitored therapeutic areas, monitored products, the publications source URL, ticketing API URL, and Slack channels.
4. Run once from Manual Trigger - Test Run to confirm fetching, filtering, classification, and ticket creation all work end to end.

### Customization
- Adjust which tags count as a match in JS - Filter by Monitored Therapeutic Areas & Products.
- Tighten or loosen what Claude classifies as Urgent vs Routine in the AI Agent prompt.
- Add a weekly digest of all Routine tickets for periodic compliance audit.

## Stage 1: Discovery & Deduplication

- **Schedule Trigger - Poll Regulatory Sources** — polls on a schedule (default daily) to start each monitoring cycle.
- **Manual Trigger - Test Run** — lets you run the whole workflow on demand for testing.
- **Set - Config** — central place for monitored therapeutic areas/products, source URLs, ticketing settings, and channels.
- **HTTP - Fetch Regulatory Publications** — pulls the latest publications from the regulatory source API. 🔑
- **JS - Normalize & Deduplicate Publications** — reshapes the raw response and drops publications already seen in a prior cycle.
- **IF - New Publications Found?** — branches to relevance filtering if anything new was found, else ends the cycle.
- **No Action - End Cycle** — ends the run with no AI call when nothing new was published.

## Stage 2: Relevance Filtering & AI Classification

- **JS - Filter by Monitored Therapeutic Areas & Products** — keeps only publications matching your configured areas/products.
- **IF - Relevant Publications Remain?** — branches to full-text fetch if any relevant publications remain, else ends here.
- **No Action - No Relevant Matches** — ends the run when none of the new publications are relevant to you.
- **JS - Fan Out Relevant Publications** — splits the relevant list into one item per publication for individual processing.
- **HTTP - Fetch Publication Full Text** — pulls the full text/detail for each relevant publication. 🔑
- **Anthropic - Regulatory Intelligence Model** — the Claude model used by the classification agent. 🔑
- **AI Agent - Classify & Summarize Regulatory Update** — classifies therapeutic area/product impact, summarizes implications, and assesses urgency.
- **JS - Parse AI Classification & Summary** — safely parses Claude's structured JSON output.

## Stage 3: Ticket Creation & Team Routing

- **Switch - Route by Urgency** — routes each update to an urgent ticket + alert, or a routine ticket, by urgency level.
- **HTTP - Create Compliance Ticket (Urgent)** — opens a high-priority compliance ticket for urgent updates. 🔑
- **Slack - Alert Compliance Team (Urgent)** — posts an immediate alert for urgent regulatory updates. 🔑
- **HTTP - Create Compliance Ticket (Routine)** — opens a normal-priority compliance ticket for routine updates. 🔑
- **Merge - Combine Ticket Branches** — merges the urgent and routine branches back into one flow.
- **Slack - Notify Regulatory Intelligence Channel** — posts a summary of the update and its ticket to the team channel. 🔑
- **JS - Update Seen Publications Store** — records this publication as seen so next cycle only looks at what's truly new.
